REQ-TIED_RUNTIME_DISK_CONFIG.name: Runtime disk configuration
REQ-TIED_RUNTIME_DISK_CONFIG.description: Operator global paths (store root, MCP dist, client corpus) are install-managed on disk via .tied/store.yaml, .tied/store.local.yaml, and client MCP JSON—not shell exports.

rationale.why: NON-TIED bootstrap pass shipped resolver and install writers; project REQ/ARCH/IMPL traceability was missing.
problems_solved: Shell TIED_* env overrides silently diverge from install-managed config
Store refresh and MCP spawn lack documented satisfaction criteria
benefits: CLI, IDE MCP, and agentstream share one on-disk contract
Fail-closed diagnostics before MCP spawn when surfaces missing

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: Client resolves MCP dist and corpus from MCP JSON without shell global path env.
Store resolves from .tied/store.yaml merged with store.local.yaml overlay.
MCP layer refresh writes or updates store.local.yaml with dist paths.
Shell TIED_MCP_BIN, TIED_REPO_ROOT, TIED_STORE_ROOT do not override install-managed global paths.
Missing config surfaces emit DIAGNOSTIC and non-zero exit before MCP spawn.
Store install refresh updates on-disk .tied paths and client mcp.json env.
Committed store .tied/ with tied-store-config.v1 is not flagged as legacy layout junk.
Store self linked methodology refresh skips DOCS_TO_COPY when store doc path equals dest.
